question: What do those devoid of self-awareness essence not know?
premises: devoid of essence of self-awareness throb
not indeed this shiva peaceful named
inference: The verse says those lacking the essence of self-awareness do not know that peaceful Shiva is not some differentiated being.
plain_english: They do not know, being devoid of the essence of self-awareness throb; indeed this Shiva, peaceful-named, is not some differentiated one.
